text:
jamie_sales: Quick heads-up — Lyric wants a short POC using a customer-converted GGUF (mistral-xxl-q4_kv). They asked for a compatibility check, tokenizer sanity, KV-cache compatibility, KMS + IP allowlist instructions, and an estimated dedicated pricing for 2 weeks. Can SE/infra/security triage?

priya_se: Got it. First Qs: do they have the GGUF + tokenizer.json ready? Also need target latency (p50/p95) and expected QPS pattern. Function-calling or streaming?

jamie_sales: They will provide the GGUF and tokenizer.json. Target: p50 <150ms for ~64-token prompts. Burst up to 20 qps, average ~5 rps. No streaming, deterministic outputs required for evals.

marco_infra: We support q4_kv in the runtime but customer-exported GGUF can be flaky. Two quick checks: 1) tokenizer vocab size match; 2) runtime kv cache smoke test. Run this locally if they share files:

```
python tools/convert_to_redwood.py --input model.gguf --out /tmp/mistral_redwood --quant q4_kv
redwood-runtime inspect /tmp/mistral_redwood --kv-test
```

If inspect errors, send artifact to infra and I can run a trace.

priya_se: I'll kick off a model-scan in the onboarding tool (checks tokenizer mismatch, op compatibility, perf regressions). Link: https://console.redwood.dev/model-scan?id=TEMP_TOKEN

elena_sec: Security checklist: are they sending production data (PHI/PII)? For POC we need data residency and retention details and whether PII scrubbing is required. Hosted environments need KMS integration work; Dedicated/Private can accept customer-managed keys. Also confirm export-control provenance since weights are customer-owned.

jamie_sales: They'll use synthetic/scrubbed prompts. Plan is to run in a Dedicated reserved seat for 2 weeks. KMS will be customer-managed.

rachel_legal: If customer provides weights, we need MSA + weights attestation (export control). Recommend scoped SOW for the POC to avoid full onboarding. I can prepare an attestation template. Need customer legal contact and entity details.

marco_infra: Fallback plan if the q4_kv conversion fails: route to a validated quantized variant (mistral-33b-lite). Suggest a canary routing policy so evals can compare outputs without downtime:

```
route:
  primary: mistral-xxl-q4_kv
  fallback: mistral-33b-lite
  canary: 10% traffic for 24h
```

priya_se: Ballpark for Dedicated reserved for 2 weeks (2x A100-equivalent nodes to hit 20 qps): ~$9k reservation + ~$1.5k storage & ops. Add ~25% for 24/7 scaling. Final numbers from finance.

jamie_sales: Need a short preflight checklist to send to the customer and internal owners. Can someone draft?

priya_se: Draft preflight checklist: 1) model artifact (GGUF + tokenizer.json), 2) sample prompt set and eval metrics, 3) target RPS and latency SLOs, 4) data residency / PHI confirmation, 5) KMS key ARN + IP allowlist, 6) export-control attestation, 7) desired POC start date and time zone.

elena_sec: Add: requested retention period for logs/outputs, whether they require PII scrubbing, and whether they'll sign a BA if healthcare data is involved. For regulated data we require Private deployment or BA + controls.

deploy-bot: [CI] model-scan job started job_id=ms-3314456790-1 (status: queued) :gear:

marco_infra: If they can't share weights, offer an NDA + presigned S3 upload where infra runs the conversion and returns a scan report without persisting copies. I'll own the conversion step.

jamie_sales: I'll ask Lyric for the artifact, attestation, and prompt set. Can we have a short internal sync tomorrow 10:30am PT to finalize SOW and quote?

priya_se: 10:30am PT works for me. Marco/Elena/Rachel?

marco_infra: +1

elena_sec: Free then

rachel_legal: I'll review SOW draft asynchronously but can join if needed :thumbsup:

jamie_sales: Thanks all — I'll set calendar invite and paste the preflight into the shared doc. :raised_hands:
